title: "practical"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
first8 <- c(37,52,65,89,24,19,54,67)
patients <- tibble (
  dose = rep(first8, times = 10),
  ER = rep(c(TRUE,FALSE), each = 40)
)
beta0 <- 3
beta.er <- 2
beta.dose <- 0.1
```

```{r}
X <- model.matrix(~ER + dose, data = patients)
X.int <- model.matrix(~ER * dose, data = patients)

head(X)
head(X.int)
```

```{r}
beta <- c(beta0, beta.er, beta.dose)
Y <- X %*% beta
head(Y)

```

```{r}
ggplot(patients, aes(x = dose, y = Y, colour = ER)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm')
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
Y.OBS <- Y + rnorm(length(Y))
ggplot(patients, aes(x = dose, y = Y.OBS, colour = ER)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm')
```

```{r}
beta.OBS <-  solve(t(X) %*% X, t(X) %*% Y.OBS)
print(beta.OBS)
```

```{r}
patients$Y.OBS <- as.numeric(Y.OBS)
fit <- lm(Y.OBS ~ ER + dose, data = patients)
print(summary(fit))
print(confint(fit, level = 0.90))
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
N <- 10000
included.dose <- numeric(N)

for (i in 1:N) {
  tmp <- as.numeric(Y) + rnorm(80, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  res <- summary(lm(tmp ~ ER + dose, data = patients))$coefficients["dose", 4]
  included.dose[i] <- (res < 0.05)
}

mean(included.dose)
```

```{r}
m1 <- lm(Y.OBS ~ ER + dose, data = patients)
m2 <- lm(Y.OBS ~ ER, data = patients)

anova(m1,m2)
m <- lm(Y.OBS ~ 1, data = patients)
anova(m1, m)
```

```{r}
x <- runif(1000, min=1, max = 10)
y <- exp(1/x)
plot(x,y)
e <- rnorm(1000, mean = 0, 0.25)
yobs <-  y + e
plot(x,yobs)
```

```{r}
expfit <- lm(yobs ~ x)
summary(expfit)
plot(x, residuals(expfit))
```

```{r}
expfit  <- lm(yobs ~ x)
expfit2 <- lm(yobs ~ x + I(x^2))
expfit3 <- lm(yobs ~ x + I(x^2) + I(x^3))

anova(expfit, expfit2, expfit3)
```

```{r }
ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = fitted(expfit),  colour = "expfit"))  +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = fitted(expfit2), colour = "expfit2")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = fitted(expfit3), colour = "expfit3")) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = yobs, colour = "observed"))
```

```{r}
realfit <- lm(yobs ~ I(exp(1/x)))
print(anova(expfit, expfit2, expfit3, realfit))

ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = fitted(expfit),  colour = "expfit"))  +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = fitted(expfit2), colour = "expfit2")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = fitted(expfit3), colour = "expfit3")) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = yobs, colour = "observed")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = fitted(realfit), colour = "realfit"))
```

```{r}
m4 <- loess(yobs ~ x)
summary(m4)
plot(x, yobs)
points(x, fitted(m4), col = 2)
```

# Covid-19 Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
covid19 <- read_csv("ClassCOVIDData.csv")
covid19$icu <- factor(covid19$icu, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
covid19$sex <- factor(covid19$sex)  # recode labels here too if you know the coding
```

```{r}
summary(covid19)
ggplot(covid19, aes(x = age, fill = icu)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5)
```
